dataset: UCI Bank Marketing: original published bank.csv 4,521-row subset
currentUciAttribution: Moro, S., Rita, P., & Cortez, P. (2014). Bank Marketing. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
originalDescriptionAttribution: Moro, S., Laureano, R., & Cortez, P. (2011). Using Data Mining for Bank Direct Marketing: An Application of the CRISP-DM Methodology. ESM 2011, pp. 117–121; retained original bank-names.txt.
transformation: Retain each original last-contact duration in seconds and its one-based published source-row index; remove all other fields. No sampling, sorting, winsorization, rescaling or synthetic records.
limits: Published subset order is not arrival order. No arrival/start/departure timestamps, waiting times, fitted arrival rate, IID service or stationary queue assumptions are identified. Queue calculations would be conditional hypothetical models.
